Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30293-04.htm.text: Priest Manuel: The leaf of the Oracle represents the noble spirit of those that fulfill Eva's will. Take it and meet the High Priest. Then you will be able to change profession to an Elven Oracle.

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30293-02.htm.text: Priest Manuel: I see you are not an Elven Mystic. I have made a mistake. I am sorry, but this task can only be entrusted to an Elven Mystic.

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30293-02a.ht.text: Priest Manuel: Ah! I see you are an Oracle that has already perceived the truth of light and life. Leave this task to the Elven Mystics, and go out into the world to fulfill the holy will of Eva.

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30293-03.htm.text: Priest Manuel: Thank you for your offer, but I am afraid that this mission might prove too difficult for you. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
